cr_data.provenance:
1928- collection of the artist; 1933 Whitney Museum of American Art, New York 
(Source: Whitney Museum of American Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Whitney ArchiveMM [*sic* Whitney Museum of American Art] 1950. . . . Not signed on front. Sold to Whitney Museum. Painted 1928" [notes verso inscription]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Whitney got it in 1933." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on board', Whitney Museum of American Art as 'Oil on wood'. (Source: Information provided by the Whitney Museum of American Art for the *Access O'Keeffe* review, 2025)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, inscription in museum files: "'Single Lily with Red' (oil) – 1928 – by Georgia O'Keeffe, Exhibition Feb–March 1929 signed on back of painting" (Alfred Stieglitz, label: printed, The Intimate Gallery, black ink).
titles.title: Single Lily with Red

credit_line: Whitney Museum of American Art, New York; purchase
description: A white calla lily with a curved, trumpet-like petal stands prominently in the center of the frame. The white flower and its bright green stem contrast with a large, dark green leaf behind it. A bright red background is visible behind the leaf.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Whitney Museum of American Art.
title: Single Lily with Red
